title: Helwit Mocha Extra Strong Nicotine Pouches 15mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Mocha Nicotine Pouches (Extra Strong) bring together bold coffee flavour and subtle cocoa sweetness for a warm, full-bodied profile. The richness of the roasted coffee is softened by mellow chocolate notes, making this a smooth but impactful choice for users who enjoy darker, more robust blends. With 15mg of nicotine per pouch, this is one of the strongest in the Helwit range, providing a longer-lasting, more intense nicotine release. The slim, plant-based pouch fits neatly under the lip and delivers clean satisfaction without smoke, vapour or odour. Made in Sweden using climate-compensated manufacturing, Helwit Mocha Extra Strong is perfect for users seeking a deeper flavour with stronger delivery. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
